title: A Tale of Two Cities: The Announcement Effect of Northern Metropolis Plan
abstract: arXiv:2609.19032v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Using the October 2021 announcement of Hong Kong's Northern Metropolis Plan as a quasi-natural experiment, we examine its impacts on households, firms, and demographics. Leveraging 100,576 housing transactions, 4.7 million consumption records, and district-level demographic data, difference-in-differences estimates show housing prices in the treated region rose by 3.9% within one year, alongside a 4.1% increase in consumption. Firm entry expanded, with inflows of higher-income, higher-educated households. We find a mild, lagged spillover to Shenzhen's housing market but no significant firm response. While the policy narrows cross-region inequality, it increases within-region inequality and raises affordability concerns for lower-SES households.

translated_title: 双城记：北部都会区计划的公告效应
translated_abstract: 本文利用2021年10月香港北部都会区计划的公布作为准自然实验，考察了该政策对家庭、企业和人口结构的影响。基于100,576笔住房交易、470万条消费记录和区级人口统计数据，双重差分估计显示，受影响地区的房价在一年内上涨了3.9%，消费同步增长4.1%。企业进入数量有所增加，同时伴随高收入、高学历家庭的流入。研究发现该计划对深圳住房市场产生了温和且滞后的溢出效应，但对企业行为没有显著影响。尽管该政策缩小了跨区域不平等，却加剧了区域内部的不平等，并引发了对于较低社会经济地位家庭住房负担能力的担忧。
tldr: 本文以香港北部都会区计划公布为准自然实验，发现该政策使目标区域房价一年内上涨3.9%、消费增长4.1%，吸引高收入高学历家庭流入，虽缩小了跨区域不平等，但加剧了区域内部不平等和住房负担问题。
en_tdlr: Using Hong Kong's Northern Metropolis Plan announcement as a quasi-natural experiment, this paper finds the policy raised treated-region housing prices by 3.9% and consumption by 4.1% within a year, attracting higher-income educated households, while narrowing cross-region inequality but exacerbating within-region inequality and affordability concerns.
